Name: Nebelung Fluffy Grey Cat Recolor - Long Hair no Stripes
Author: BrassyDel
Description:
This mod changes the cat in your Stardew Valley game. In addition to recoloring the cat I added some fluffiness to the tail, back feet, and
belly. Also made ears pink inside. Made by request! Coloring is a Nebelung, which is a long haired cat breed with the same coloring as a Russian Blue. I also removed the stripes, so this is a solid color grey cat.

[center][color=#8e7cc3][size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size][/color][/center]


1. Always back up your original game files!

2. Find your Stardew Valley game files. If you use Steam, this will be:
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\SteamApps\common\Stardew Valley\

3. Your cat is saved here:
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\SteamApps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Animals

4. Make a copy of your original Cat.xnb file.

5. Cut, copy, or drop your new Cat.xnb into this folder. Select Replace when prompted.

6. Load up your game, and you should now have a new kitty. Enjoy!
